key_insight: AI can help decode, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D inorganic perovskites (CsPbX3) by linking degradation mechanisms to reliability and design strategies.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights how AI can accelerate more stable perovskite device development for photovoltaics, photodetectors, and light-emitting devices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
method: Consequence/reliability modeling and engineering stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that existing studies are challenged by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based analysis.
watch_item: Current AI approaches are limited by data quality, inconsistent protocols, weak benchmarks, interpretability gaps, and poor transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
